signal: Closed4h EMA50>EMA200 and last3 EMA50 increments positive. In1h, each of previous4 ATR14 values <75%of mean of its own previous50 ATR observations. Current close>highestHIGH previous12bars, volume>=1.5*mean previous20volumes, bullish body>=0.5*previousATR14. false->true1h. Limit=floor prior12high; stop=floor prior12low-0.25*previousATR14; target=floor limit+3*(limit-stop).
execution: Post at following1h open proxy; limit must be below open*(1+spread/2) else cancel post_only-cross proxy. Expiry5minutes [placedAt,placedAt+300000), no chase/taker conversion. Use confirmed1m throughout entry hour. Fill only low<limit-penetrationTicks*tick, capped by minute base-volume*participation, quantized downward. Touch is no fill. No native book/queue guarantee.
partial: Reserve unfilled cash, protect filled inventory immediately in simulation, cancel remainder on exit/timeout. If net sellable partial is below minimum, cancel remainder and block replay with inventory unresolved; no invented subminimum sale. Fees in base on buy, quote on taker sell; dust explicit conservative writeoff.
intrabar: Stop-first/gaps; no take-profit credit in a minute containing a new fill. Other entry-hour minutes allow target. Later candles use frozen1h OHLC stop-first/gap model. No same-hour portfolio reuse. Compression trailing never acts on the candle used to propose its update; initial stop remains until a valid future proposal.
netGate: Projected netRR>=1.5 and net gain>=2*roundtrip modeled cost; round-down and after-base-fee sellable quantity included. Plannedstoprisk<=1%equity.
portfolioGuards: Existing3%daily,10%drawdown new-entry halts and1h cooldown after3losses; no claim of native kill-switch validation.
dataPolicy: Collect only60confirmed1m bars for each raw signal execution hour inside known development window; duplicate/conflict/gap/hour disagreement blocked. Freeze source before performance replay. Missing minutes =>no90dportfolio result, not zero trades. Candles cannot authenticate maker role, queue/side or exact intrabar path.
promotion: Any favorable modeled result is only conditional research screening. No independent-data collection, Demo/real approval, native order, deployment or production parameter change in this execution.
trailing: Only after net liquidation PnL at a fully closed1h bar>=2*initial net stop risk of actual filled/sellable position: arm trailing. Use highest closed1h CLOSE since entry minus2*current closed1h ATR14, rounded down. Never lower stop; crossed/invalid proposals ignored; update effective following hour only. No partial exit or independent breakeven.
